notes: Source: OECD Economic Outlook annex workbook "Demand and output", sheet RealGDP (Annex Table 1. Real GDP), Internet Archive capture 20040804085215 of http://www.oecd.org/dataoecd/6/27/2483806.xls. The sheet says "Source: OECD.". Identified as EO75 (June 2004): created 2004-06-15 and saved 2004-06-25 (file metadata), annual columns end in 2005, and the values match the EO75 flash file (created 2004-05-10, capture 20041025174758 of http://www.oecd.org/dataoecd/18/26/2713584.xls). Values are annual percent change of real GDP, rounded here to 3 decimals (transcribed values keep the printed 1 decimal). Aggregates (OECD total, euro area) use the composition of the time. Not in source for this edition: China 2004, China 2005, India 2004, India 2005, Brazil 2004, Brazil 2005.
